newsitem.title: UK: Goode Durrant says hire rates under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Goode Durrant says hire rates under pressure.

text.p: Goode Durrant Plc said on Friday at its annual general meeting that competition has continued to be "keen" with hire rates remaining under pressure, as recently highlighted in its report and accounts.
"As yet there is only limited evidence that the climate for hire rates is improving," said chairman Michael Waring, speaking at the annual general meeting.
The company, which hires out vehicles, added that despite the above conditions, gearing remains low and good opportunities for expansion exist.
